verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Floot has a credit-based plan (add-on credits instead of upgrade/downgrade) and notes that MCP usage runs on the user's Claude/ChatGPT subscription rather than consuming Floot credits, giving some indication of what consumes credits vs not. However there's no evidence of a clear breakdown of which specific in-app actions (generate_image, execute_sql, checkpoints, etc.) cost how many credits, nor a pricing page detailing plan tiers/limits. missing for 10: a transparent per-action credit cost breakdown, a pricing/plan comparison page, and documentation explaining plan quotas or overage costs.
